posts.en:
dsh-skin-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0ede791f205beec7effe.html
